units.source_text: 不管怎么说，老师的无言，又形成一种不安，天天压在我的身上。

en.t: In any case, the teacher's silence became another source of unease, weighing on me every day.

units.source_text: 老师的存在变成了一股巨大的力量，恍如在眼前烦人地飞来飞去的飞蛾的影子。

en.t: The teacher's presence turned into an immense force, like the shadow of a moth annoyingly fluttering back and forth before my eyes.

units.source_text: 按照惯例，老师应邀外出做法事时，是会由一两名待僧陪同的，

en.t: By custom, when the teacher was invited out to perform a Buddhist service, one or two attendant monks would accompany him,

units.source_text: 原先一定是由副司陪伴，最近实行所谓民主化，

en.t: formerly it had always been the vice steward who accompanied him, but recently, under the so-called democratization,

units.source_text: 便由副司、殿司、我以及另两名弟子等五人轮流承担。

en.t: the duty was taken in turns by five of us: the vice steward, the hall steward, myself, and two other disciples.

units.source_text: 至今人们还常常背地里议论舍监的好挑剔，舍监入伍后战死了。

en.t: Even now people often spoke behind his back about how fussy the dormitory supervisor had been; after being drafted, he died in the war.

units.source_text: 因此，会监一职由现年45岁的副司兼任。

en.t: For that reason, the post of assembly supervisor was also held by the vice steward, who was now forty-five years old.

units.source_text: 鹤川逝世后，又补充了一名弟子。

en.t: After Tsurukawa died, one more disciple was added.
